hooks.command: HOME_DIR="${REKOL_HOME:-$MEMORY_HOME}"; IDX="$HOME_DIR/REKOL.md"; [ -f "$IDX" ] || IDX="$HOME_DIR/MEMORY.md"; if [ -n "$HOME_DIR" ] && [ -f "$IDX" ]; then echo "[rekol] $HOME_DIR loaded — consult $(basename "$IDX"), when/*.md, topics/*.md, or run rekol search"; cat "$IDX"; elif [ -z "$HOME_DIR" ]; then echo '[rekol] memory home not configured (set REKOL_HOME)'; else echo "[rekol] no REKOL.md found in $HOME_DIR — run ./install.sh to seed it, or create REKOL.md"; fi
